{{Quote|These Sand People are tiring me. I must save my strength for my mission!|Darth Maul|<ref name="DMR" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was '''ambushed''' by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Maul, a [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]], had been tasked by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], to eliminate [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who protected [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|ruler]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Sidious wanted to capture the Queen and have her sign a treaty allowing the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

After following the Jedi's trace to Tatooine, Maul was ambushed by a group of thirty Tusken Raiders in a canyon. As he wished to save his strength for the upcoming [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with the Jedi, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] decided to run away from the battle.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Tracking down the Jedi should be simple enough. And once I defeat them, the Queen will be back in my master's hands. I will not fail.|Darth Maul|<ref name="DMR" />}}
[[32 BBY/Legends|Thirty-two years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] planned on capturing [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He wished to force the Queen to sign a treaty that would legitimize the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupation]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The invasion was part of a [[Grand Plan/Legends|grand plot]] hatched by Sidious, a part of his scheme to establish himself as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], beneath his public persona of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine.<ref name="TPM" />

In his secret lair on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the Galactic Republic, Sidious tasked his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]],<ref name="TPM" /> a [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]]<ref name="EncyclopediaMaul">{{SWE|characters|darthmaul|Darth Maul}}</ref> [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> known as [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], with eliminating [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who were protecting Queen Amidala. According to the trace provided by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], Maul knew that the Queen's [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type royal starship]] was on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TPM" /> The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] then set course to the remote and sparsely populated planet aboard his personal stealth [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']]. After being [[Darth Maul/Legends#Togorian Pirate attack|attacked]] by [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] upon exiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] and escaping with a wound to the leg, Maul made a night landing on an isolated mesa close to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="DMJ" /><ref name="The Wrath of Darth Maul">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>

==The ambush==
{{Quote|The Sand People advance on me angrily. In their breath masks and goggles they are protected from the sand that now stings my eyes and clogs my mouth.|Darth Maul|<ref name="DMJ" />}}
[[File:Maultrap.png|thumb|left|150px|Darth Maul, about to be assaulted by Tusken Raiders]]
After sending his [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] to track down Qui-Gon Jinn, Maul spent the night aboard the ''Scimitar''. The next morning, he woke up early to practice his Sith [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|art of battle]]. After beating two [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] he had brought with him that were similar to those he used to fight when he was younger, the Dathomirian noticed [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] tracks circling his ship. Fearing it may have been a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] sent by the Jedi, Maul decided to investigate and followed the prints in the sand.<ref name="DMJ" /><ref name="DMR">''[[Darth Maul's Revenge]]''</ref>

The tracks led him over the dunes and into a canyon. While he was scanning the canyon in search for lifeforms, a riderless bantha lurched into sight around a rocky wall, temporarily breaking the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] concentration. Suddenly, a lone [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand Person]] rose from the shadows under the cliff and tried to attack Maul with his [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]] stick. The Dathomirian activated one end of [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|his]] [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaff]] and cut the Raider's weapon in two with one stroke of his [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|bloodshine]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade.<ref name="DMJ" /><ref name="DMR" />

After a brief sparring match, Maul prepared himself to [[Death/Legends|strike his opponent down]]. However, the desert warrior wasn't alone, and Maul had just fallen into a trap. A flock of at least thirty other Sand People appeared, spilling out from behind the cliff where they were hidden. Soon, the Raiders began to surround the Sith. While he thought that he could have easily defeated five of them, Maul understood that it would only infuriate the rest of the group. The Tusken Raiders kept maneuvering Maul closer to the face of the canyon wall. As the only way out was to avoid the fight, Maul quickly enacted a fallback strategy. He ran straight for the canyon wall and managed to scale it. With a burst of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] strength, Maul performed a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-enhanced backward flip, flew in the air and landed behind his attackers.<ref name="DMJ" /><ref name="DMR" />

The unexpected move left the Sand People temporarily stunned. Maul grasped the opportunity to run, and headed back to his ship through the canyon. The Raiders eventually engaged in chasing the Sith, but they couldn't match his speed. Once they were left one hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] behind, they finally gave up and walked away, in hopes of finding easier prey.<ref name="DMJ" /><ref name="The Wrath of Darth Maul" /><ref name="DMR" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|If he's heading out of town on foot, he must be going to his ship. No time to waste!|Darth Maul, about Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="DMR" />}}
[[File:Maulaftermath.png|thumb|150px|Darth Maul locates the position of Qui-Gon Jinn.]]
Maul had never run from battle before, but he knew that he would not have easily succeeded in defeating all of the Raiders. Nevertheless, the retreat filled him with rage, and he was willing to tap into his feelings of fury during the upcoming fight. Back at the ''Scimitar'', he received a report from one of his Dark Eye probes. The collected coordinates indicated that Jinn was heading out of Mos Espa spaceport, most likely returning to the Queen's ship, in the company of a [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|local boy]]. The [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] warrior got on the [[Bloodfin/Legends|''Bloodfin'']], his personal [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], and raced through the sands of the [[Star/Legends|sun]]-scorched planet.<ref name="DMJ" /><ref name="The Wrath of Darth Maul" /><ref name="DMR" /> When he finally reached his Jedi prey, Maul engaged in his [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|first duel]] with Jinn. The outcome of that duel was indecisive, as the Jedi successfully disengaged from the battle and quickly leaped aboard his ship, the boarding ramp of which had been lowered to rescue him.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ambush on Tatooine first appeared in the eighth chapter of the [[March]] [[2000]] novel, [[Star Wars Journal: Darth Maul|''Star Wars Episode I Journal: Darth Maul'']], written by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="DMJ" /> In [[November]] of the same year, a visual interpretation of this event was included in ''[[Darth Maul's Revenge]]'', a young readers book written by [[Eric Arnold]] and illustrated by [[Tommy Lee Edwards]].<ref name="DMR" />
